tables.title: Annual Procurement Plan Summary - Summary by Office (FDP Form 4b)

values.head: Ms. Claire V. Cabalda, REB, MPA

notes: Region VII, Province of Cebu, Lapu-Lapu City. The Form 4a item list (pages 1-10, 163 items) has no office grouping, subtotals or grand total; page 11 (Form 4b, printed sideways) gives a total cost per office, transcribed as table summaryByOffice. No grand total is printed, so summary.total is null.
The sum of the items per PMO/End-User matches every printed office total on the Form 4b summary exactly (CGSO, CMO, CTO, DEP-ED, HRMDO, LDRRMO, LLCH, SRCH, Various Offices).

The four schedule sub-columns (Advertisement/Posting of IB/REI, Submission/Opening of Bids, Notice of Award, Contract Signing) are one merged cell reading "January 2026- October 2026" on every row; transcribed as a single schedule column.

Several capital items (vehicles, aircon, CT scan, school buildings, etc.) are printed under the MOOE column rather than CO; transcribed as printed. CO is filled only for some LDRRMO equipment and the HRMDO aircon.

Some rows have no Code (PAP) printed (null). Codes are copied as printed, including odd ones such as "9998-1-07-06-990-26s5" and "5-02-03-990.2". Mode text "COMPETITVE" (typo on the form) normalised to "COMPETITIVE".

Page 1 and page 2 each carry a CTO "Packed Meals" row with the same code and amount (1,400,000.00) but different remarks; both are separate items (the CTO office total 2,800,000.00 confirms this). Likewise two identical LDRRMO first-aid-kit rows (3,000,000.00 each) and two identical "Early Warning System" rows (1,400,000.00 each) are printed and kept.
